meta.headline: PhD Computer Science
meta.description: PhD student in Computer Science and software developer. Portfolio showcasing research projects, education and open-source contributions.

summary.title: Summary
text: Research focused on Differential Privacy and parameter-efficient fine-tuning of LLMs, with papers on tabular data synthesis, memorization risks, and explainable governance of synthetic health data.
Engineering experience in Python and C, covering ML pipelines, evaluation frameworks, and high-throughput data platforms.

items.title: Towards Explainable Governance of Synthetic Health Data in Collaborative Healthcare Ecosystems
subtitle: A. Pelusi (University of Insubria, Varese, Italy)
A. Trombetta (University of Insubria, Varese, Italy)
D. Spoladore (CNR, Milan, Italy)

items.title: chesSLM
subtitle: Decoder-only Language Model Trained on Chess Games
bullets: Engineered a ~100M-parameter Transformer from scratch in PyTorch featuring Pre-LN blocks, Rotary Positional Embeddings (RoPE), and FlashAttention kernels.
Trained via a two-stage curriculum (mixed precision, gradient accumulation, cosine decay) and packaged as a standalone UCI chess engine rated ~1650 Elo.
